description: Variation of Condition 2 (Approved Plans), 4 (Cycle Parking) and 9 (Garden Division) for the new layout of the garden area incorporating cycle storage for both flats following planning 01203/305/P15 dated 01/03/2023 for the conversion of the house into two self contained residential units
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission 01203/305/P15 dated 1 March 2023

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Unnumbered Proposed Site Plan, SD2115(P)105 received 30 June 2023   and shall conform in all other respects to the drawings and documentations approved under planning permission  01203/305/P15: Unnumbered Site Location Plan, SD2112(P)101, SD2112(P)102, SD2112(P)103-A, Design & Access Statement, Fire Safety Statement received 16 December 2022; Energy Statement received 30 January 2023.

Condition : 4 - No residential unit shall be occupied until space has been laid out within the site in accordance with approved plan Unnumbered Proposed Site Plan for 4 bicycles to be parked and that space shall thereafter be kept available for the parking of bicycles; prior to commencement of the use. The approved facilities shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance (or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout.

Condition : 5 - a)	The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy.
b)	Prior to first occupation of any dwelling within the development hereby approved evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions, and achieved a 55% reduction in emissions.
c)	Upon final commencement of operation of any low and zero carbon technologies, suitable devices for the monitoring of the low and zero carbon technologies shall have been installed, and the monitored data shall be submitted automatically to a monitoring web-platform at daily intervals for a period of three years from the point of full operation.

Condition : 6 - Prior to first occupation of the development the applicant shall have entered into a formal agreement with the Council to provide a payment of ?4,338 towards its Carbon Offset Fund, as outlined in the hereby approved Energy Statement.
Condition : 7 - Prior to first occupation of the development hereby approved, the development shall have been constructed to achieve an internal water use of 105 litres/person/day or less.

Condition : 8 - The approved refuse and recycling store as shown on approved plan Unnumbered Proposed Site Plan shall be completed and made available for use before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, and thereafter shall be retained for such use at all times without obstruction. Bins shall be stored within the store at all times and shall not be left on the public highway.

Condition : 9 - The rear garden shall be sub-divided as shown on the approved plan Unnumbered Proposed Site Plan and thereafter maintained as such for the duration of the development hereby permitted.
